subject: general
question: Sadhvi Dhuri, who was one of the most successful athletes at the Khelo India University Games, is a professional:
solution:
The correct answer is __**swimmer.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Bhubaneswar swimmer** Sadhvi Dhuri earned two gold medals,** while Mihir Ambre won his** second championship to lead Savitribai Phule Pune University** (SPPU) to the top of the medal standings.
 
• **The 200m freestyle was won by the 19-year-old Sadhvi Dhuri **handily in 2:14.99, and the 100m butterfly was won by her after a close race with **Damini Gowda** (Rajiv Gandhi University of Health Sciences).
 
• **Dhuri prevailed by a 0.60-second **margin in one of the most thrilling races. She now has three gold medals after the two victories. ​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Athletes from universities all over India **compete in the Khelo India University Games, a national level multi-sport competition, in a variety of **sporting disciplines.**
 
• The first edition, **hosted in Odisha**, began on February 22 and ended on March 1, 2020.
 
• The** 2020 edition featured 211 competitions **across 17 sports and was held from 22 February to 1 March 2020. The sporting events took place in the **SAI-Odisha Badminton Academy**, JNL Indoor Stadium, Kalinga Institute of Industrial Technology (KIIT) in Bhubaneswar, and **SAI International Residential School in Cuttack.**
